top_creatures.label: Three-band toughness scale
top_creatures.why: The armour-class column of the species table clusters in three bands (roughly 0 to 138, 250 to 273, 620 to 644). A readable three-step threat tier on a card at 375 wide. Inference: the bands are tiers; not confirmed.
top_creatures.keep: Three threat bands as the tier signal.
top_creatures.change: Show as a threat ring with three steps, not a number.
top_creatures.ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/xyeppp-RoR-Interface/interface/interfacecore/tome/bestiary/species.csv:2 (row shape; band counts by awk, not receipted)

top_creatures.label: Subtype family card
top_creatures.why: Each creature row points to a subtype, and each subtype points to a type and a portrait. The card can be built from the row, so the family is the grouping.
top_creatures.change: A silhouette tile and one colour per family.

top_creatures.label: Uneven three-way realm split
top_creatures.why: Three realm groups with uneven sizes (38, 140 and 132 rows). A three-way split that is not even reads as a real contest.
top_creatures.keep: A three-way split with uneven sides.
top_creatures.change: Our own names and a different sign for each side.

looks.label: Death and respawn card

looks.technique: 1.5 second pop-and-ease flash on a hit-point drop, a reference-counted enable gate; the countdown in OnUpdate is commented out so the timer never ends and later flashes do not start (as read, not run in game)

looks.label: Take-one loot row

looks.technique: action bars, cast timer, mouse-over target, objective trackers, overhead map, world map, zone control, public-quest loot and a layout editor, each as a module; names from the folder list, not opened

looks.label: Sigil fragment ladder
looks.technique: fragments with 0 to 5 tasks feed sigils; the task table has 4 to 6 tasks per fragment task

originals.name: Respawn Choice Card
originals.idea: A death card with three abstract respawn choices and a timer ring that the loss stays readable through.
originals.keep: Respawn options on death, an auto-respawn timer, a live killer line.
originals.change: Three abstract choices with no place names; a timer ring; a short last-hit line with a sting.

originals.name: Rim Flash with a Working Timer
originals.idea: A hit-feedback rim vignette that flashes on each hit-point drop and an off switch.
originals.keep: Flash driven by hit-point drops; enable gate.
originals.change: A rim vignette in a threat colour, not a full-screen tint; the countdown ends so every later hit can flash.

originals.name: Take-One Loot Row
originals.idea: Three loot cards in a row; hover or tap to inspect, then take one.
originals.change: Three cards at 375 wide, a rarity bar and a lid-lift ceremony with a sound per rarity.

originals.name: Bestiary Silhouette Card
originals.idea: Each creature is one data row and its card is built from that row.
originals.change: A silhouette tile and a three-step threat ring in place of numeric fields.

originals.name: Sigil Pip Ladder
originals.idea: A gear slot filled by a set number of fragment tasks, shown as pips.
originals.keep: Fragments with a fixed task count fill a slot.
originals.change: A pip ring per task with a short tick; each sigil tier has its own ability, not one shared ability.
